1	name: Nightly Install Smoke
2	
3	# Every other E2E workflow builds the CLI from source. This one installs the
4	# published nightly the way a user does and runs one smoke test per agent
5	# against it, on each OS.
6	
7	on:
8	  schedule:
9	    # 3h after nightly.yml tags at 06:00, so release.yml has published.
10	    - cron: "0 9 * * *"
11	  workflow_dispatch:
12	    inputs:
13	      test:
14	        description: "Test name filter (regex)"
15	        required: false
16	        # Keep in sync with the TEST_FILTER fallback below, which is what a
17	        # scheduled run uses.
18	        default: "TestMultiSessionSequential"
19	
20	concurrency:
21	  group: nightly-install-smoke
22	  cancel-in-progress: true
23	
24	jobs:
25	  smoke:
26	    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
27	    # Above the sum of the agents' own retry ceilings (~85m: 9 + 18 + 13.5 +
28	    # 13.5 + 18 + 13.5, see the step caps below) plus setup, so the per-step cap
29	    # is always the one that binds — a step timeout leaves an attributable row
30	    # in the table, a job timeout kills Summarize and the artifact upload with
31	    # it. Legs measure 6m30s-8m40s; this only binds on a hang in one of the
32	    # uncapped setup steps.
33	    timeout-minutes: 90
34	    permissions:
35	      contents: read
36	      actions: read
37	      # For copilot-cli. Permissions are job-wide, so the install steps see
38	      # this scope too — accepted: they install and run the binary every later
39	      # step executes with the agent keys and this token, so withholding it
40	      # there guards nothing. Public repo, so only the Copilot quota has value.
41	      copilot-requests: write
42	    strategy:
43	      fail-fast: false
44	      matrix:
45	        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
46	    env:
47	      # What a first-run `entire enable` writes (setup.go). Unset, the harness
48	      # pins legacy git-branch, which no fresh install has.
49	      E2E_CHECKPOINT_STORE: git-refs
50	      TEST_FILTER: ${{ github.event.inputs.test || 'TestMultiSessionSequential' }}
51	      # Not $PWD: under Git Bash that is /d/a/cli/cli, which the Go test binary
52	      # resolves against the current drive.
53	      ARTIFACT_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/e2e/artifacts
54	
55	    steps:
56	      # Install first, checkout second: the ref comes from the installed
57	      # binary's version. GITHUB_TOKEN because the installers resolve the tag
58	      # through the releases API, which 403s unauthenticated from a shared
59	      # runner IP (reported as "check your internet connection").
60	      - name: Install nightly CLI (Linux)
61	        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
62	        env:
63	          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
64	        run: |
65	          set -euo pipefail
66	          curl -fsSL https://entire.io/install.sh | bash -s -- --channel nightly
67	          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
68	
69	      - name: Install nightly CLI (macOS)
70	        if: matrix.os == 'macos-latest'
71	        run: |
72	          set -euo pipefail
73	          brew tap entireio/tap
74	          brew trust entireio/tap
75	          brew install --cask entire@nightly
76	
77	      # The README's nightly invocation. The installer updates only the stored
78	      # user PATH, which later steps do not re-read, hence GITHUB_PATH.
79	      - name: Install nightly CLI (Windows)
80	        if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest'
81	        shell: pwsh
82	        env:
83	          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
84	        run: |
85	          iex "& {$(irm https://entire.io/install.ps1)} -Channel nightly"
86	          "$HOME\.local\bin" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8 -Append
87	
88	      # Pin the checkout to the tag that produced the installed binary, so the
89	      # harness and the CLI under test come from one commit.
90	      - name: Resolve nightly tag and binary path (Unix)
91	        if: matrix.os != 'windows-latest'
92	        run: |
93	          set -euo pipefail
94	          version_line=$(entire version | head -1)
95	          echo "$version_line"
96	          tag="v$(echo "$version_line" | awk '{print $3}')"
97	          # Fail closed: a stable or unparseable version means the install
98	          # resolved the wrong channel.
99	          case "$tag" in
100	            v*-nightly.*) ;;
101	            *) echo "expected a v*-nightly.* version, got '$tag'" >&2; exit 1 ;;
102	          esac
103	          {
104	            echo "NIGHTLY_TAG=$tag"
105	            echo "E2E_ENTIRE_BIN=$(command -v entire)"
106	          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
107	
108	      - name: Resolve nightly tag and binary path (Windows)
109	        if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest'
110	        shell: pwsh
111	        run: |
112	          # Stop is what makes the Write-Error below terminating. The runner
113	          # prepends it too, but this step depends on it, so it says so.
114	          $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
115	          $versionLine = (entire version | Select-Object -First 1)
116	          Write-Host $versionLine
117	          $tag = "v$($versionLine.Split(' ')[2])"
118	          # Fail closed: a stable or unparseable version means the install
119	          # resolved the wrong channel.
120	          if ($tag -notlike "v*-nightly.*") {
121	            Write-Error "expected a v*-nightly.* version, got '$tag'"
122	          }
123	          "NIGHTLY_TAG=$tag" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
124	          "E2E_ENTIRE_BIN=$((Get-Command entire).Source)" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
125	
126	      - name: Checkout the nightly tag
127	        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
128	        with:
129	          ref: ${{ env.NIGHTLY_TAG }}
130	          # An agent process runs in this checkout; keep the token out of
131	          # .git/config.
132	          persist-credentials: false
133	
134	      - name: Setup mise
135	        uses: jdx/mise-action@f10502fc09dadecfefb962fff68ce77213930204 # v4
136	
137	      # TestMain's preflight requires tmux off Windows, even for headless tests.
138	      - name: Install tmux (Linux)
139	        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
140	        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y tmux
141	
142	      - name: Install tmux (macOS)
143	        if: matrix.os == 'macos-latest'
144	        run: brew install tmux
145	
146	      # Excluded everywhere: gemini-cli (forces core.hooksPath='' since 0.57.0,
147	      # so nothing is checkpointed), pi (no CI installer), vogon and
148	      # roger-roger (not shipped agents).
149	      - name: Install agent CLIs (Unix)
150	        if: matrix.os != 'windows-latest'
151	        run: |
152	          set -euo pipefail
153	          curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
154	          curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash
155	          curl -fsSL https://app.factory.ai/cli | sh
156	          # opencode by npm: its install script resolves its version through an
157	          # unauthenticated api.github.com call it gives no way to authenticate,
158	          # so it is rate-limited at random.
159	          npm install -g @openai/codex @github/copilot opencode-ai
160	          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
161	          echo "AGENTS=claude-code opencode codex cursor-cli factoryai-droid copilot-cli" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
162	
163	      # cursor-cli is absent: its E2E driver sends every prompt through tmux
164	      # (e2e/agents/cursor_cli.go), because Cursor's headless -p mode fires no
165	      # hooks — and there is no tmux on Windows.
166	      - name: Install agent CLIs (Windows)
167	        if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest'
168	        shell: pwsh
169	        run: |
170	          irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex
171	          npm install -g @openai/codex @github/copilot opencode-ai
172	          # Stop does not cover native commands ($PSNativeCommandUseError-
173	          # ActionPreference defaults to $false), so npm's failure needs this.
174	          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "npm install failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
175	          # The iex line needs no such guard: that installer throws or exits on
176	          # every failure path, and both end this step. Verified 2026-09-09.
177	          "$HOME\.local\bin" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8 -Append
178	          # factoryai-droid is left out, installer included: on Windows it
179	          # fails "checkpoint state did not advance within 30s" while passing on
180	          # Linux and macOS (runs 34131195807, 34127634577) — a real defect in
181	          # its hook path. Restoring means this name plus
182	          # `irm https://app.factory.ai/cli/windows | iex` and ~\bin on PATH.
183	          "AGENTS=claude-code codex copilot-cli opencode" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append

185	      # One step per agent: a step timeout is the only per-agent bound that
186	      # works on all three runners (macOS has no timeout(1)), and one hung agent
187	      # in a shared loop would take every later agent's verdict with it.
188	      # `!cancelled()` so a killed step does not skip the rest.
189	      #
190	      # 20 minutes is sized from the harness's retry ceiling, not from the
191	      # observed 23s-2m40s: runForAgents gives each scenario attempt
192	      # 3 min x the agent's TimeoutMultiplier and allows 3 attempts, so a
193	      # transient-error restart chain it is designed to recover from takes up to
194	      # 18 min for the 2.0x agents (opencode, factoryai-droid). A tighter bound

201	      # E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR because the mise task otherwise derives one shared dir

203	      #
204	      # E2E_ENTIRE_BIN (job env, set above) is what makes this the *installed*

# Nightly Install Smoke run 34583415795: two defects, two PRs

## Context

Run https://github.com/entireio/cli/actions/runs/34583415795 (schedule, 2026-09-11) failed on
`smoke (windows-latest)`. Two independent problems:

1. **Workflow reporting.** Every "Smoke test <agent>" step is green even when its agent failed;
   only "Summarize" turns red. Reader has to open the step summary to learn *which* agent failed.
2. **Real CLI regression on Windows for Copilot CLI.** `TestMultiSessionSequential/copilot-cli`
   fails (both attempts) with `shadow branches should be cleaned up within 10s after commit,
   found: [entire/6503d24-e3b0c4]`. Linux and macOS pass; the previous nightly
   (`v0.10.7-nightly.202609100626.0138471ae`, run 34459813849) passed on Windows.

### 1. Why the agent step is green and Summarize is red

`.github/workflows/nightly-e2e.yml`, steps "Smoke test …" (lines 208–317). Each body is:

```bash
set +e
…
mise run test:e2e --agent "$AGENT" "$TEST_FILTER"
rc=$?
grep -q '^Total: 0 ' … && rc=1
echo "$AGENT $rc" >> e2e/artifacts/results.txt     # last command → step exit 0
```

`set +e` was added in 3830520fe when all agents ran in ONE loop step, so one failure would not
abort the loop ("the Summarize step is what fails the job"). f86b1a60c then split the loop into
one step per agent gated on `!cancelled()`, but kept the body verbatim. Nothing ever propagates
`rc`, so the step's exit status is that of the trailing `echo`. The per-step gating already
makes propagating it safe: `!cancelled()` runs later agent steps after a failed one, and
Summarize/Upload are `always()`. Only the *display* is wrong; the job verdict and Slack notify
are unchanged.

### 2. Why Copilot on Windows leaves a shadow branch

Evidence from the artifacts (`nightly-smoke-windows-latest` for both runs, `entire.log`):

| | passing nightly 0138471ae | failing nightly 5f09e04de |
| --- | --- | --- |
| post-commit → `session condensed`, `shadow branch deleted` | yes | yes |
| post-commit `files_touched_before` (copilot) | 0 | **1** |
| agent-stop, 2s after the commit | `no files modified during session, skipping checkpoint` | `files changed during session modified=1` → `created shadow branch … entire/6503d24-e3b0c4` |

Same on Linux in the failing run: "no files modified". Same Copilot version both nights
(`npm view @github/copilot dist-tags` → latest 1.0.83 since 2026-09-04). Codex on Windows already
had `files_touched_before=1` on the passing night, so the 0→1 flip is Copilot-specific.

Chain:

- **Trigger — PR #2341 (`feat(copilot-cli): track subagent tasks`, merge 5f09e04de, the exact
  commit the failing nightly was cut from).** `copilotcli/transcript.go`
  `extractModifiedFilesMatching` now falls back to `toolTelemetry.restrictedProperties.filePaths`
  when `properties.filePaths` is empty. Copilot 1.0.83 puts the paths there, so Entire's Copilot
  transcript analyzer went from returning nothing to returning `docs/blue.md`. This is a correct
  improvement; it exposed a latent bug.
- **Bug — `filterToUncommittedFiles` (`cmd/entire/cli/state.go:332`)** is the turn-end guard
  that drops transcript-reported files already committed mid-turn. It compares
  `readWorktreeFileSafely` raw bytes with `headFile.Contents()` (`string(working) != head`,
  line 388). The e2e repo sets `core.autocrlf=true` (`e2e/testutil/repo.go:88`, and it is the
  Git-for-Windows default). Copilot's Create tool writes CRLF on Windows; `git add` stores LF.
  Raw bytes ≠ blob → file "still uncommitted" → `SaveStep` mints `entire/<newHEAD>-e3b0c4` after
  condensation already ran. Nothing condenses it again (the turn is over), so it outlives the
  session. On Linux Copilot writes LF, so the comparison happens to match.
- **Precedent — PR #2336 (`Handle autocrlf in carry-forward detection`, #913)** fixed the same
  class of bug on the post-commit path: `strategy/content_overlap.go:513-547` hashes worktree
  candidates through `gitrepo.HashWorktreeFiles` (`git hash-object`, filter-aware) and falls back
  to the confined raw hash `workingTreeMatchesBlob` only when git cannot hash the path. The
  turn-end filter was never converted. The second caller of the filter (subagent capture,
  `lifecycle.go:1897`) has the same exposure.

## Plan

Two isolated PRs (one objective each).
